title: Clinical Value of Self-assessment Risk of Osteoporosis in Chinese
brief_summary: This cross-sectional study aimed to validate the effectiveness of the combined use of the Osteoporosis Self-Assessment Tool for Asians (OSTA) and the One-Minute Osteoporosis Risk Test (IOF test) in a population from Wuhan, China.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* age of at least 20 years, able to read and fill out the questionnaire, and willingness to participate.

Exclusion Criteria:

* severe liver, heart, or kidney impairment, and tumor. Procedures of the study were in accordance with the Declaration of Helsinki and were approved by the local ethics committee.
study_population: age of at least 20 years, able to read and fill out the questionnaire, and willingness to participate.
